newsitem.title: USA: Reliance Steel sees Q3 shr short of Q2's.
newsitem.headline: Reliance Steel sees Q3 shr short of Q2's.

text.p: Reliance Steel & Aluminum Co's third quarter earnings will be a little shy of the $0.74 a share earned in the second quarter, president David H. Hannah told Reuters on Tuesday.
Speaking after an analysts' meeting, he said the current quarter marks the end of 10 consecutive quarters of increased profits, but it will still exceed last year's $0.55 a share.
He also said the the company continues to be comfortable with analysts' estimates it will earn $2.75 to $2.80 in all of 1996 compared with 1995's $2.18.

Hannah earlier told the Salomon Brothers' investors seminar the softness in the second half of 1996 is being caused by lower results at the company's Valex Corp subsidiary, which serves the semiconductor industry.
